_about: Phase 3 (failure modes, similar-report search, early-warning signals) success criteria, pre-registered 2026-11-21 before any reference label or method output existed. Judged by mdqc.verify_phase3. Later changes are labelled post hoc in docs/FAILURE_MODES.md.

reference_labels.sample: config/phase3_sample.csv: 40 reports per product code drawn by md5 order (text-blind); first 20 per code = validation, next 20 = test
reference_labels.labeller: Claude (the AI coding assistant) labels every sample report with one primary mode from config/failure_modes.json, reading the report text (mdqc/textprep.py), before any method is run; labels are committed (config/phase3_labels.csv) before method outputs exist. The user then reviews 20 labels drawn by md5 order (10 validation, 10 test) and records agree/disagree.
reference_labels.spot_check_rule: If the user agrees with fewer than 16 of 20 (80%), the codebook and labels are revised and everything after is labelled post hoc.

methods.M1_fda_terms: FDA device + patient problem terms mapped by config/failure_modes.json fda_term_map; several modes -> family priority; none -> *_OTHER. Settings: none.
methods.M2_keywords: Codebook keyword regexes on the report text (case-insensitive). Settings chosen on validation: 'earliest' (the mode whose first match appears earliest in the text) or 'priority' (the highest-priority mode with any match). No match -> *_OTHER.
methods.M3_embedding: bge-small-en-v1.5 (BAAI, CPU): cosine similarity between the report text and each mode's definition (query prefix 'Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages: '); best mode, or *_OTHER if the best similarity is below a threshold. Settings chosen on validation: threshold in {none, 0.55, 0.60, 0.65}.
methods.M4_hybrid: M2 (with its chosen setting) when any keyword matches, else M3 (with its chosen setting).
methods.M5_tfidf_kmeans: TF-IDF (1-2 grams, min_df 5, English stop words) + k-means per family on all reports of the family (k = number of modes, seed 0); each cluster named by the majority reference label among VALIDATION reports in it (clusters with no validation report -> *_OTHER).

selection_and_test.primary_metric: accuracy of the primary mode (all codes pooled); secondary: macro-F1 over modes, per-family accuracy
selection_and_test.selection: the method + setting with the highest validation accuracy (ties -> simpler: M1 < M2 < M3 < M4 < M5) is the chosen method
selection_and_test.test: every method's chosen setting is scored once on the 100 test reports: accuracy with a 95% bootstrap interval (2,000 resamples of reports, seed 0)
selection_and_test.claim_rule: the chosen method is called better than the FDA-term baseline (M1) only if the paired bootstrap 95% interval of (chosen - M1) test accuracy is entirely above 0

similar_reports.methods: R1 BM25 (rank-bm25, Okapi defaults, simple word tokens), R2 bge-small cosine, R3 hybrid reciprocal-rank fusion of R1 and R2 (k=60)
similar_reports.evaluation: each labelled report whose mode is not *_OTHER is a query; candidates = the other labelled reports of the same code in the same split; relevant = same reference mode. Metrics: MRR (primary) and precision@5
similar_reports.selection: highest validation MRR; test MRR reported for all three with 95% bootstrap intervals; chosen vs BM25 claimed only if the paired interval is above 0

signals.series: monthly report counts by date_received for each (product code, parent company, failure mode from the chosen method), 2022-01 to 2024-12
signals.rule: month t (2023-01 or later, so 12 months of history exist) is a SIGNAL if count_t >= 5 and the Poisson probability of seeing count_t or more, with mean = average of the previous 12 months (at least 0.5), is below 0.001
signals.backtest: recall events (distinct res_event_number) of the scope codes initiated 2023-01-01..2024-12-31, matched to (product code, parent company of the recalling firm). HIT if that (code, parent) has any signal (any mode) in the initiation month or the 6 months before it. Base rate = share of all (code, parent, month) 7-month windows from 2023-07 to 2024-12 that contain a signal, for (code, parent) pairs with at least one report. Reported: hits / recall events, base rate, signals per year. No tuning: one registered rule.
signals.caution: a signal is a prompt to look, not evidence of a defect; recalls are few and concentrated in a few companies, so the backtest is descriptive

criteria.F1_order: git history shows codebook + sample + criteria committed before the labels, and the labels committed before any method output (results/phase3/).
criteria.F2_spot_check: the user's review of 20 labels is recorded in config/phase3_spot_check.csv; agreement >= 16/20, else the post hoc rule applies.
criteria.F3_selection: the chosen method was selected on validation only (verifier recomputes validation accuracies from saved predictions and confirms the choice).
criteria.F4_test: test accuracy, intervals and the chosen-vs-M1 comparison are recomputed by the verifier from saved predictions with independent code.
criteria.F5_retrieval: retrieval MRR / precision@5 recomputed by the verifier from saved rankings.
criteria.F6_signals: signals and the backtest recomputed by the verifier from the database with independent code: identical.
criteria.F7_database: every report has exactly one mode from the chosen method in core.report_failure_mode; counts per mode equal the saved full-corpus predictions.
criteria.F8_ci: unit tests (keyword rules, M1 mapping, Poisson rule, metrics) and the verifier on a fixture run in CI.
